tools.name: search_empty_legs
tools.description: Search empty-leg private jet flights currently published for the UK and Europe. A country or region matches when either airport is in that place. Prices are indicative, copied from the publishing source, and are not a quote. Each row includes the source name, the source URL, and fetchedAt, which is

tools.name: get_leg
tools.description: Return one published empty leg by id, including the route, date, aircraft, indicative price or price band, each source name and source URL, and fetchedAt (when this index collected the row, not a live quote). An unknown id returns an error and no leg. This does not hold or book the seat.

tools.name: list_sources
tools.description: List every configured empty-leg source: its id, public page, whether it is enabled, and the last refresh result (when it was attempted, whether that attempt worked, how many valid legs it yielded, and the failure text when it failed). A disabled source is not fetched. A source named in ELI_DISABLED_

tools.name: submit_enquiry
tools.description: Store an enquiry about one published leg and return a reference. The result includes the sentence "No booking or payment made; the operator will contact you / enquire via their link" and the operator or broker's own booking URL. It does not reserve a seat, charge a card, or confirm the flight still

tools.name: set_alert
tools.description: Store a free email alert for new empty legs on a route. Set an origin, a destination, or both. Each end is an airport (city, name, or IATA or ICAO code) or a country (ISO code or English name, for example GB or France). originCountry and destinationCountry name the country for that end when you want

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_empty_legs, get_leg · Private data: search_empty_legs, submit_enquiry · Public sink: submit_enquiry, set_alert · Destructive: set_alert.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_empty_legs, get_leg · Private data: search_empty_legs, submit_enquiry · Public sink: submit_enquiry, set_alert · Destructive: set_alert

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
